title: A shop term held by one customer and two vendors names only those two
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop's own term is used by one customer and two vendors, but by no invoice.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • The shop has its own active term {Term-A}, due 14 days after the invoice date, held by 1 customer and 2 vendors and by no invoice.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S2-15 Fourteen.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  2. Hover "Edit".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu shows exactly these items, in this order: "Edit" (pencil, greyed out), "Make Default for New Customers" (circle check), "Move Customers" (person), "Deactivate" (archive), "Delete Credit Term" (trash, in red, below a divider, greyed out). Nothing else shows.
  • Step 2: the hover reads "Used by 1 customer and 2 vendors" with "Deactivate it instead to take it out of the pickers." below it.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11671 (Story 2, Row menu actions)

  • S2-R2: “"{holders}" names only the holder types the term has, each with its count, singular or plural: for example "Used by 1 customer and 2 vendors", "Used by 12 customers, 3 vendors and 40 invoices", "Used by 5 invoices".”
